commands.review_summary:
The PR adds Policy doctor fix metadata and automatic required-deny repairs that append missing policy-required tools to global or per-agent deny lists, plus related docs and tests from its stacked Policy series.

PR surface: Source +993, Tests +535, Docs +32, Other +8. Total +1568 across 18 files.

Reproducibility: not applicable. as a bug reproduction; this PR adds new Policy doctor repair and metadata behavior. Source review confirms current main lacks the repair handlers and the PR adds them.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] Human review remains because the PR is draft/protected and stacked, the metadata blocker is still actionable, and contributor-provided real behavior proof is still mock-only.

target.title: policy: repair required deny tool findings
target.body:
## Summary - add required-deny automatic repairs for policy doctor findings - merge missing required tools into the exact `tools.deny` / agent tool deny config path reported by the finding - cover dry-run preview behavior and scoped agent deny repair validation - preserve the automatic-repair workspace opt-in inherited from #99690  ## Stack - Stacked on #99690 (`policy: repair automatic narrowing findings`) - #99690 is stacked on #99686, which is stacked on #99121 - Keep draft until the lower policy stack lands or is rebased onto `main`  ## Validation - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/metadata.test.ts --reporter=dot` (290 tests) - `pnpm exec oxfmt --check extensions/policy/src/doctor/automatic-repairs.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/scopes/tools.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts` - `pnpm exec oxlint extensions/policy/src/doctor/automatic-repairs.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/scopes/tools.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts` - `pnpm tsgo:extensions` - `git diff --check` - `codex review --base origin/policy-doctor-automatic-narrowers` (clean)  ## Not run - `pnpm tsgo:core` (local worktree still has unrelated untracked `src/oc-path/` files that have blocked core typecheck on unused symbols in this stack)

## Real behavior proof

Behavior or issue addressed:
`doctor --fix` repairs required deny-tool findings by merging missing required tools into the reported `tools.deny` or agent workspace deny path, with dry-run previews and scoped agent validation.

Real environment tested:
Windows PowerShell in `C:\src\openclaw-fork` on the restacked policy series, top head `283c1bb4ca` and this PR head `62010b65a1`. This is a source-harness proof; it does not start a packaged OpenClaw binary or make live LLM calls.

Exact steps or command run after this patch:
1. `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/policy/src/doctor/metadata.test.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/strictness.test.ts src/flows/doctor-repair-flow.test.ts --reporter=dot`
2. `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs test/scripts/plugin-sdk-surface-report.test.ts --reporter=dot`
3. `pnpm tsgo:extensions`
4. `pnpm lint:extensions`
5. `git diff --check`

Evidence after fix:
The focused policy/core Vitest run passed 10 core repair-flow tests and 297 policy doctor tests, including `dry-runs required tool deny repairs without mutating config` and `repairs required agent workspace deny tool findings`. The SDK surface tooling test passed 7 tests. `tsgo:extensions`, `lint:extensions`, and `git diff --check` all exited 0.

Observed result after fix:
Required deny repairs preserve existing deny entries, add only the missing required tool ids, and keep dry-run behavior non-mutating.

What was not tested:
No packaged CLI smoke, live provider run, or live LLM call was run for this source-harness proof.
